First public build of the C128+ core for MiSTer: a Commodore 128 with 256 KB RAM, two SIDs in stereo, the VIC-IIx graphics chip and BASIC 7.1. No Z80, no VDC.

## Files

| File | Where it goes |
|---|---|
| `C128plus_*.rbf` | `/media/fat/_Computer/` |
| `boot2.rom` | `/media/fat/games/C128plus/` (BASIC 7.1) |
| `*.prg` | test programs, load with `DLOAD` or from the OSD |

The core also needs the original C128 ROMs, which are not included: `boot0.rom` (system ROMs) and `boot1.rom` (drive ROMs) in `/media/fat/games/C128plus/`.

## What's in it

- **256 KB RAM**; Z80/CP/M, VDC, REU, OPL2 and GeoRAM removed.
- **Two SIDs**: the second at `$D420`, 50% stereo mix by default.
- **VIC-IIx** (unlocked by BASIC 7.1 at start-up): 24 sprites (up to 8 per raster line), a 256-colour palette (16 on screen), hardware coarse scrolling (screen start offset, row length, separate sprite pointer page). See [docs/VIC-IIx.md](https://github.com/gus0650/C128plus/blob/main/docs/VIC-IIx.md).
- **BASIC 7.1** (`boot2.rom`):
  - `SPRITE`, `MOVSPR`, `RSPRITE`, `RSPPOS`, `BUMP`, `SPRSAV` for sprites 1–24, `SPRPTR`, `PALETTE`, `RPALETTE` – see [docs/BASIC71-Graphics.md](https://github.com/gus0650/C128plus/blob/main/docs/BASIC71-Graphics.md)
  - `SOUND`, `PLAY`, `VOL`, `FILTER` for six voices on both SIDs, `SID6 ON/OFF` – see [docs/BASIC71-Sound.md](https://github.com/gus0650/C128plus/blob/main/docs/BASIC71-Sound.md)

## Test programs

- `gfxtest.prg` – sprites 1–24, `SPRPTR`, `SPRSAV`, palette
- `sprtest.prg` – `MOVSPR` in all forms, `RSPPOS`, `RSPRITE`, `BUMP`
- `colltest.prg` – collisions of all 24 sprites, `BUMP` 1–6, `COLLISION`
- `sid6test.prg` – six-voice sound and stereo

Each prints the value it should show next to the result.

## Known limitations

- Collision detection and `SPRSAV` for sprites 9–24 have not been tested on hardware yet.
- `SPRDEF` (the sprite editor) still handles sprites 1–8 only; use `SPRPTR` or `SPRSAV` to give its shapes to sprites 9–24.
- The FPGA timing constraints are incomplete: this build is known to work, but rebuilding with other settings may not.

Based on [C128_MiSTer](https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/C128_MiSTer).
